For vehicles with annual mileage below '20,000 Km' there is an annual inspection plan which includes the following:

  • Check condition / wear of tyres and, if necessary, adjust inflation pressure (including spare wheel).
  • Check operation of lighting system (headamps, direction indicators, hazard warning lights, luggage compartment, passenger compartment, glove compartment, instrument panel warning lights, etc.).
  • Check operation of windscreen wash/wipe system, jet adjustment.
  • Check positioning / wear of windscreen/rearscreen wiper blades
  • Check condition and wear or front disc brake pads
  • Visually inspect condition of: engine, gearbox, transmission, pipes (exhaust, supply, fuel, brakes), rubber elements (boots, hoses, bushes, etc.), braking and fuel system hoses.
  • Check battery charge.
  • Visually inspect condition of various drive belts
  • Check and, if necessary, top up fluid levels (engine coolant, braking system, windscreen washer, battery, etc.).
  • Change engine oil
  • Change engine oil filter
  • Change active charcoal combination particle filter
